newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Uzbek President Karimov to visit Greece.
newsitem.headline: Uzbek President Karimov to visit Greece.

text.p: Uzbek President Islam Karimov leaves on Monday for a three-day official visit to Greece, a Foreign Ministry official said.
Karimov was to hold talks with Greek President Costis Stephanopoulos and the country's parliamentary chairman, the spokeswoman told Reuters by telephone from the Uzbek capital Tashkent.
The leader of the former Soviet republic, a major cotton and gold producer, was also due to meet Greek businessmen.
"But the most important event within the framework of the visit will be the signing of a friendship and cooperation treaty between both countries," the official said.
